webDerivative.reason: The repository has no governed WebP conversion step. No derivative is fabricated and no browser conversion dependency is introduced.

provenance.workflow: Generated through the Firefly web interface driven by Claude Code in the owner's browser, then Adobe cutout and tone alignment plus a deterministic local extract and normalization

selectedGeneration.requestIdReason: The Firefly web interface exposes no generation request id; the resulting Firefly asset URN identifies the generation.
selectedGeneration.sourceResolutionNote: The Firefly web interface returned 512 x 512 for this run, unlike the 2048 x 2048 the API produced for the first eight layers. The master is upscaled from this source and is measurably softer.
selectedGeneration.promptRevisionReason: The briefed wording produced the wrong subject and was sharpened: cucumber came back halved lengthwise, lettuce came back as a whole head, meat came back as a geometric stack.
selectedGeneration.briefPrompt: A scattered handful of small hand-torn iceberg lettuce pieces spread loosely as one flat airy layer, individual ruffled pale-green leaf fragments with curled edges, no intact lettuce head, no core, no bowl, photorealistic premium Mcello food photography, one single horizontal layer spanning most of the frame width, lying almost flat with visible thickness at the front edge, isometric view exactly 45 degree angle, studio lighting with direct warm top light and soft downward shadow, solid black background, centered, entire subject in frame, clean separation, no other objects.
